question: Dhangari Gaja is a folk dance of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhangari Gaja** is a popular folk dance form of **Maharashtra**, which is performed during various festive occasions.
 
• The dance is performed by a group of **male dancers **who wear **colorful traditional attire** and play musical instruments like **dhol, tasha, and cymbals.**
 
• The dance form is known for its **vigorous movements and acrobatic stunts** performed by the dancers.
 
• The word **"Dhangari"** means** shepherd** and** "Gaja" **means** elephant**, which represents the strength and power of the dancers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Folk dances of **Assam** includes **Bihu, ****Bagurumba, Bhortal and the Ojapali dance.** ​
 
• Folk dances of** Telengana** includes **Gussadi dance, ****Dhimsa**** dance, Lambadi dance, ****Perini Sivatandavam****, and Dappu dance.**
 
• Folk dance of **Uttarakhand** includes **Choliya, Jhumelo, Pandavart / Pandava Leela, Langvir Dance, Chanchari and Chhapeli.**
